scope: Acesse sua conta gov.br login interface
notes: Evaluated keyboard navigation, focus indicators, form validation, semantic structure, and ARIA attributes. Two main accessibility issues identified: error message not properly associated with input field, and first section labeled by paragraph instead of heading.

findings.description: Error message is not properly associated with input. Input lacks aria-invalid='true' and error message lacks id/role='alert'. The input should have aria-errormessage or aria-describedby pointing to the error message. When form validation fails, the error message appears but is not semantically connected to the field.

Section is labeled by a paragraph (

) element instead of a heading element. Should either have role='region' explicitly or be labeled by a heading element (h1-h6) for proper semantic structure and accessibility tree representation.
